race.comment: HAZARDOUS (11) is a promising filly who won easily on debut two back at Wodonga. Dropped back 200m in trip but still got the job done here last time. Shows adaptability and a great will to win. Facing her stiffest test to date she is up to the challenge. JUSTENUFFSPLASH (9) appeared for the first time in nine weeks when an even fourth over 1175m at this track last start. Has a win and a placing from two runs over today's trip. Likes racing here and looks a serious threat to the top pick. CHRISTMAS STAR (3) started in the red but found one marginally better over this distance at the Sapphire Coast recently. In the money at ten of 13 runs over today's journey. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and looks sure to feature in the finish. Expect a better run today from DOLLY (4) who wasn't disgraced last start in open company. FOURTHTIMELUCKY (8) has won two from three when second-up so expect a big improvement on what he did here when resuming.
